::: {#sol-avg-log-prob}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
bigram_log_probs = torch.log(bigram[val_ids[:-1], val_ids[1:]])
bigram_nll = -bigram_log_probs.mean().item()
uniform_nll = math.log(n_chars)
print(bigram_nll, uniform_nll)
```

The average is `r sprintf("%.2f", py$bigram_nll)`.
The uniform model of @exm-language-model gives every character probability $1 / `r py$n_chars`$,
so its average is $\log `r py$n_chars` = `r sprintf("%.2f", py$uniform_nll)`$.
The lower average means the [bigram model](#def-bigram-model) gives the validation text higher probability.
This average is the [cross-entropy loss](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/logistic-regression.html#def-cross-entropy-loss) of the model's predictions of the validation characters.

:::
